name: Mizuno Corporation
summary: Mizuno Corporation manufactures and sells sports products in Japan, the rest of Asia, Europe, the Americas, and Oceania. The company offers baseball products, sportswear, sports shoes, baseball products, golf products, and lifestyle products. It is also involved in the construction of sports facilities; operation and contract operation of sports entrustment; school business; and manufacturing and sales of sports equipment, exercise programs, and working products. The company was founded in 1906 and is headquartered in Osaka, Japan.
